description: Set up a whole video project at once: every script for a client or campaign, filed into folders, ready for the user to film one at a time. Use this when there is more than one video to make — a product launch, a client's month of content, a shot list someone sent over. Use create_video_shoot instead for a single video the user wants to film right now. Every script is stored word for word and cut into takes automatically; nothing is rewritten and nothing is filmed or published. The user works through the project under Shoots in oriiion, where each shoot opens a teleprompter and camera on their phone.

folderPath.description: REQUIRED. Folder the whole project goes under, levels separated by '/' — e.g. 'LogitechG/Pro X Launch'. Created if it doesn't exist. Imported shoots are always filed into a folder so a project never lands loose among the user's other work — call list_shoot_folders first to reuse a folder that already exists.

shoots.description: The videos in this project. Each one needs `script` or `segments`; a topic alone is not enough.

folder.description: Subfolder for this one shoot, nested inside folderPath — e.g. 'Teasers'

script.description: The exact words to say on camera. Filmed verbatim.

segments.description: Pre-cut takes, if you already know where the camera should stop and start. Otherwise pass `script` and oriiion cuts it.

direction.description: One short, concrete instruction for what to do with the phone

text.description: What to say in this take. Leave empty for a silent b-roll take.

title.description: Short internal name for this video

name: create_shoot_project
title: Create Shoot Project
